openingStatement: Some ideas need to be dismantled before they can be understood.
description: abstractly concrete. the art of unthinking. An interactive exhibition of paintings and writing by giles c mccrary iii.

abstractRoom.title: abstract your own concrete.
abstractRoom.hint: A word, an object, a certainty — anything you hold as fixed.
abstractRoom.privacy: what you type stays in your browser unless you choose to leave it for others.

field.title: the field.
field.subtitle: every piece here was abstracted by a visitor and left for the next.
field.consent: Your piece joins the field anonymously: only the letters and their arrangement are kept, nothing about you. Leaving it means it can be shown as part of this collective work by giles c mccrary iii, on this site and wherever the work is exhibited.
field.credit: abstractly concrete · giles c mccrary iii · gilesmccrary.com/field
